title: Compliance & Security
summary: GDPR, audit trails, fair-hiring checks and the controls behind them.
headline: Every decision *on the record*
lede: Hiring is a regulated decision about a person. The platform is built so each score can be explained to a candidate, a client or a regulator, and so candidate data stays yours.

capabilities.title: GDPR Compliance
capabilities.body: Lawful basis, consent and retention handled per candidate, with access and erasure requests completed from one screen.
points: Retention periods by country and role

capabilities.title: Data Privacy
capabilities.body: Candidate data is encrypted, access is limited by role, and it is never used to train shared models.
points: Encryption in transit and at rest
Your data is not used to train shared models

capabilities.title: Audit Trails
capabilities.body: Every score, note, approval and status change is logged as it happens, so an audit pack is an export rather than a project.
points: Who did what, and when, for every candidate
Exports for internal and external auditors

capabilities.title: Fair Hiring AI
capabilities.body: Models are tested for bias every quarter and the results are shared with customers unedited. A person makes every rejection.
points: Aligned with the EU AI Act for high-risk systems

capabilities.title: Security Controls
capabilities.body: The controls enterprise security teams ask for, independently audited each year.
points: SSO / SAML and enforced multi-factor sign-in

outcomes.label: Type II certified, audited every year
of scores, notes and approvals in the audit trail
bias audits, shared with customers unedited
